printers.name: Bambu Lab X1 Carbon
printers.source: Bambu Lab published X1 Carbon specifications (build volume 256x256x256 mm, hardened nozzle, enclosed chamber, hot bed to 110 degC).
notes: The enclosed chamber is why ABS/ASA/PC are practical on this machine; the warping heuristic takes the enclosure into account.
Peak speed and acceleration figures are machine maxima, not the values a real print reaches. The print-time estimate uses material flow limits instead.

printers.name: Generic open-frame printer (220 x 220 x 250)
printers.source: Generic profile provided so that printer independence of the engine is exercised, not a specific product.
notes: No enclosure: the warping heuristic applies its open-frame penalty for high-shrinkage materials.
